title: docs-notes
subHeroTitle: A place for every document your team actually needs.
subHeroDesc: Motion is your team's shared writing space — connected to your tasks, synced with Notion, and backed by an AI that can write, summarize, and organize documents for you.

sections.title: Write, organize, and find anything — without switching tools
sections.desc: Motion gives you a full document editor with folders, subpages, and a clean hierarchy. Everything your team writes lives in one place, organized the way your business actually works.

gridItems.title: Rich document editor
gridItems.desc: Write with headings, bullet lists, tables, quotes, and code — a full editing experience without the bloat.

gridItems.title: Auto-save, always
gridItems.desc: Every word you type saves automatically. Close the tab, lose the connection — your work is never lost.

gridItems.title: Nested pages
gridItems.desc: Build a proper knowledge base with pages inside pages. Great for product wikis, onboarding guides, and project docs.

gridItems.title: Folders for everything
gridItems.desc: Group related documents, specs, and files into folders and subfolders so the right people can always find the right things.

gridItems.title: Import and export
gridItems.desc: Bring in existing documents and export anything as Markdown, HTML, or PDF — ready to share with anyone.

sections.title: Your whole team can write and review together
sections.desc: Multiple people can work on the same document at the same time, leave comments, and control who can see or edit anything — just like the tools you're used to, but built into your workspace.

gridItems.title: Live co-editing
gridItems.desc: See your teammates editing in real time. No version conflicts, no 'who has the latest copy' confusion.

gridItems.title: Access control
gridItems.desc: Keep sensitive documents private, share with specific people, or open them to the whole team — your choice.

gridItems.title: Inline comments
gridItems.desc: Highlight any section and leave a comment for your team. Review cycles stay in the document, not scattered in email.

gridItems.title: Two-way Notion sync
gridItems.desc: Already using Notion? Connect it and your documents sync both ways automatically — no manual copying.

sections.title: AI that writes and organizes documents for you
sections.desc: Highlight any section and ask AI to rewrite, summarize, or translate it. Or tell your AI assistant to create an entire page from scratch — and it will.

gridItems.title: AI writing partner
gridItems.desc: Select any text and ask AI to improve it, shorten it, translate it, or change the tone — right in the document.

gridItems.title: Instant page summaries
gridItems.desc: Ask AI to summarize a long document and get the key points in seconds. No more reading through pages to find one decision.

gridItems.title: AI page creation and cleanup
gridItems.desc: Tell your AI assistant to create a new page, update an existing one, or remove outdated content — it handles the admin.

capabilitiesDesc: Motion connects your documents directly to active tasks, team permissions, and your existing tools.
checklistDesc: Motion keeps your team's knowledge organized, up to date, and connected to the work — not buried in a folder nobody opens.
checklistItems: All your team's documents in one place — organized with folders, subpages, and a structure that matches how your business actually works.
Multiple people can edit the same document at the same time. No version conflicts, no confusion over who has the latest copy.
Control who can see or edit anything. Keep sensitive docs private, share with a select few, or open them to the whole team.
AI can rewrite, summarize, or translate any section of a document on demand — saving hours on review and editing.
Already using Notion? Connect it once and your documents stay in sync automatically, both ways.
Meeting summaries can be saved directly as Motion pages with one click — so decisions never get lost in someone's notes app.
